# Nova API — /api/admin

The operations Nova tags `public` under `/api/admin`. Generated from `reference-src/nova-openapi.json`.

## GET /api/admin/query-log/export

Operation id `query_log_export`: in Python `client.call("query_log_export", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api query_log_export`.

`GET /api/admin/query-log/export?from=&cursor=&limit=` — the whole log, ascending.

Administrator only. Every stored column of the query log, oldest first, a page at a time — the read a job copies into the platform's own tables so usage outlives the 90-day window. The order is ascending (createdAt, then id), so a writer keeps the nextCursor of one page and continues from it after a restart; nextCursor is null on the last page. limit is 1 to 1000, 500 by default; from is an epoch-millisecond lower bound. With NOVA_QUERY_LOG_REDACT_LITERALS=1 every statement shows '?' in place of each string literal.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | query | string | No | The nextCursor of the previous page; rows after it, ascending |
| `from` | query | integer | No | Created at or after this time, epoch milliseconds |
| `limit` | query | integer | No | Page size from 1 to 1000; 500 by default |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | One ascending page of the whole log |
| `400` | A parameter is not valid; the message names it |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |
